ett-h1-forecasting-rolling-v1.protocol: three-fold rolling-origin validation with a sealed chronological test
ett-h1-forecasting-rolling-v1.limitations: Framework admission experiment with non-overlapping stride, one seed, and no claim of paper-table reproduction or superiority.

esa-adb-mission1-lite-v3.protocol: predefined chronological train/validation/test split with validation-only threshold selection and sealed test
esa-adb-mission1-lite-v3.limitations: Bounded six-channel ESA-lite protocol, approximate uniform-grid event metrics, one seed, and no full ESA-ADB or SOTA claim.

xjtu-sy-rul-single-split-v1.protocol: bearing-level single group split with a sealed test bearing
xjtu-sy-rul-single-split-v1.limitations: One operating condition and one group split; bearing shift prevents model-superiority or SOTA claims.

xjtu-sy-rul-group-cv-v1.protocol: four-fold bearing-level group validation with a separately sealed test bearing
xjtu-sy-rul-group-cv-v1.limitations: One operating condition and one seed; local framework evidence, not a published-protocol reproduction.
